name: Bedmi Poori & Sabzi
instructions: 1. Prepare the dough by mixing wheat flour, semolina, spices, and the coarse Urad dal paste. Let it rest for 30 minutes.
2. For the sabzi, heat oil, add hing, cumin, ginger, and green chilies. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
3. Add turmeric, red chili, coriander powder, and amchur. Stir in mashed potatoes and water, simmering until a thin gravy forms.
4. Divide the dough into small balls, roll into thick discs, and deep-fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.
5. Serve the hot, puffy poori with the spicy potato gravy.
description: Bedmi Poori is a classic breakfast staple from the streets of Mathura, Agra, and Delhi. It is deeply rooted in North Indian culinary culture, often enjoyed as a hearty weekend meal or served during festive occasions, celebrated for its unique texture and bold, spicy flavor profile.
